page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a marginal note "Nota." at the right beside the line "lum vsque euehenda". Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: Christus (Matth. 11.) nullam aliam caufam adferat, cur fapientibus abfcondatur, paruulis reueletur Euangelium, quàm patris beneplacitum.

Hæc Lutheri doctrina est, Hubere, longè certius spiritu Dei redolàs, quàm vaticinia illa quæ tu ex eo prolata ad omnes teplorum valuas adscribi, & omniu cordibus insculpi optas. Quid ni igitur in tepla omnia eam admittitis, & veftris aliorumque animis insculpitis, contentione sublata? Id si feceritis, recte: sin autem in nobis eam culpare, & soli-ta audacia velut Mahumeticam, aut Mahumetismo aliisque ineffabili malo fores aperientem, petulati stylo & lingua proscribere perrexeritis, maturè dispicite moneo, quo præcipitaturi fitis Lutheri autoritatem, in qua ad coelum vsque euehenda hactenus tanto-pere defuadastis.Nota.
main_text.head: CAPVT XII. Ad tertiam criminationem.

page.notes: Printed page with running head, page number 241; the catchword and the final line of the page are partly damaged. The marginal note "Nota." is at the right margin. Some words are uncertain in the scan, notably "Impvdens" and "damnari" at the bottom, which may be incomplete.
